title: Pure Deskbot
summary: Pure Deskbot Pendulum and Synchro OTK build with Machine Duplication, generic Machine Extra Deck bosses, and staples. Every Deskbot monster has 500 base ATK and DEF and scales rapidly with the number of Deskbot cards on the field, in the GY, or face-up in the Extra Deck.

summary.title: Starters
points: Deskbot 003 Special Summons any Deskbot monster directly from the Deck on Normal Summon and boosts a Deskbot's ATK and DEF by 500 per Deskbot card you control as a Quick Effect.
Deskbot 002 searches any Deskbot card from the Deck every time it is Special Summoned with no once-per-turn limit, and boosts all other Machines you control by 500 ATK and DEF.
Machine Duplication targets any Deskbot you control, since every Deskbot has 500 base ATK, to Special Summon up to 2 copies of Deskbot 002 or Deskbot 005 from the Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Deskbot 003 + Machine Duplication
steps: Normal Summon Deskbot 003 to Special Summon Deskbot 002 from the Deck, triggering 002 to search Deskbot Base or a Pendulum Scale.

Activate Machine Duplication targeting Deskbot 002 to summon 2 more copies of Deskbot 002 from the Deck, searching 2 more Deskbot cards such as Deskbot 005 and Deskbot 006 while giving all other Machines +1500 ATK and DEF.
If Deskbot 001 is in the GY, summoning 2 Machines simultaneously revives it for free to Synchro Summon Deskbot Jet, or Link Summon Ancient Gear Ballista and Platinum Gadget to extend further.

summary.title: Pendulum Scales & Combat Scaling
summary.text: Deskbot 005, 006, 007, and 008 form Scale 1 and Scale 10 Pendulum pairs that lock your Pendulum Summons to Deskbot monsters while in the Pendulum Zones. Deskbot 005 destroys a Spell or Trap on summon and revives a Deskbot from the GY when destroyed in the Pendulum Zone, while Deskbot 006 switches a battle position and recovers a Deskbot from the GY when destroyed. Deskbot 004 sends a Deskbot from the Deck to the GY during damage calculation to gain its Level x 500 ATK and DEF, then summons 2 Deskbots from the hand or GY after destroying a monster by battle.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Deskbot Jet is the Level 10 Synchro boss that gains 500 ATK and DEF per Deskbot card on the field and destroys a Deskbot card you control to either summon a Deskbot from the Deck or destroy a face-up card on the field.
Deskbot 009 gains the combined ATK of all other Deskbot monsters you control until the end of the turn and locks the opponent out of activating cards or effects when it attacks.
Cyber Dragon Infinity provides an omni-negate and absorbs an Attack Position monster.
Ancient Gear Ballista pops your own Deskbot 005 or 006 in the Pendulum Zone to trigger their floating effects while dropping an opposing monster's ATK and DEF to 0.

Deskbot Base boosts all Deskbots by 500 ATK and DEF, mulligans Deskbot cards from the hand, and can banish 9 different Deskbot cards from your field and GY to shuffle the opponent's entire hand, field, and GY into the Deck.

allow.Machine Duplication: Targets any Deskbot monster you control (since every single Deskbot has exactly 500 base ATK) to Special Summon up to 2 copies of Deskbot 002 or 005 from the Deck.
allow.Ancient Gear Ballista: Link-2 EARTH Machine made with two Deskbots that searches an EARTH Machine or pops Deskbot Base/Scales to reduce an opponent's monster's ATK to 0.
allow.Platinum Gadget: Link-2 Machine that Special Summons a Level 4 or lower Machine (like Deskbot 002 or 003) from the hand.
allow.Cyber Dragon Infinity: Rank 6 Machine omni-negate that absorbs opposing monsters as material.

main: Deskbot 003
Primary Normal Summon starter that Special Summons any Deskbot monster from the Deck and boosts a Deskbot's ATK/DEF by 500 per Deskbot card you control as a Quick Effect.
Deskbot 002
Searches any Deskbot card from your Deck every time it is Special Summoned (no once-per-turn limit!) and boosts all other Machines by 500 ATK/DEF.
Deskbot 004
Sends a Deskbot from the Deck to the GY during damage calculation to gain its Level x 500 ATK/DEF, then summons 2 Deskbots from hand/GY after destroying a monster by battle.
Deskbot 001
Level 1 EARTH Machine Tuner that gains 500 ATK/DEF per Machine you control and revives itself from the GY whenever 2 or more Machines are Special Summoned simultaneously.
Deskbot 005
Scale 10 Level 5 Pendulum that destroys 1 Spell/Trap on the field when Normal/Special Summoned and revives a Deskbot from the GY if destroyed in the Pendulum Zone.
Deskbot 006
Scale 1 Level 6 Pendulum that changes a monster's battle position on Summon and recovers a Deskbot from the GY if destroyed in the Pendulum Zone.
Deskbot 007
Scale 10 Level 7 Pendulum that gains 500 ATK per Deskbot in the GY, inflicts piercing damage, and protects other Deskbots from attacks.
Deskbot 008
Scale 1 Level 8 Pendulum that gains 500 ATK per Deskbot in the GY, attacks twice on monsters, and protects other Deskbots from targeting.
Deskbot 009
Level 9 OTK finisher that gains the combined ATK of ALL other Deskbot monsters you control and prevents the opponent from activating cards or effects when it attacks.
Deskbot Base

Archetypal Field Spell that boosts all Deskbots by 500 ATK/DEF, mulligans Deskbot cards from your hand, and banishes 9 Deskbot cards to shuffle the opponent's entire hand, field, and GY into the Deck.
Machine Duplication
Summons 2 copies of Deskbot 002 (triggering 2 searches and +1000 ATK to your whole board) or 2 Deskbot 005 (popping 2 backrow).
extra: Signature Level 10 Synchro boss that gains 500 ATK/DEF per Deskbot card on the field and destroys 1 Deskbot card you control to either summon a Deskbot from the Deck or destroy 1 face-up card on the field.
Link-2 EARTH Machine that pops Deskbot 005/006 in the Pendulum Zone to trigger their effects while dropping an opposing monster to 0 ATK/DEF.
Link-2 Machine that extends by summoning Deskbot 002 from the hand.
Rank 6: overlays on Nova, absorbs an Attack Position monster as material once per turn, and Quick Effect negates any card activation.
